title: Rabaul Volcanological Observatory Retaining Wall
summary: Investigation, remedial design and reconstruction of an 87 m reinforced concrete retaining wall, 4.6 m to 5.4 m high, with ongoing erosion protection.
body:
RNL was lead structural engineer on remedial works for an 87 m long reinforced concrete retaining wall between 4.6 m and 5.4 m high.

## Scope

- Site investigation
- Remedial design
- Reconstruction of the wall
- Ongoing erosion protection structures
